stops.name: Lower Saale Valley
stops.quote: A trail for all the senses - and in the middle of it all, the Lower Saale Valley and Saale-Unstrut-Triasland nature parks with quiet paths, rare species and a diverse landscape.
stops.english: A trail for all the senses - and in the middle of it all, the Lower Saale Valley and Saale-Unstrut-Triasland nature parks with quiet paths, rare species and a diverse landscape.

stops.name: ducal vineyard in Freyburg
stops.quote: Visitors to the ducal vineyard in Freyburg (Unstrut) will find a vineyard landscape.
stops.english: Visitors to the ducal vineyard in Freyburg (Unstrut) will find a vineyard landscape.

stops.name: Eckartsberga
stops.quote: From Jerichow to Eckartsberga, hikers follow the old route towards Santiago de Compostela.
stops.english: From Jerichow to Eckartsberga, hikers follow the old route towards Santiago de Compostela.

stops.name: Horburg-Maßlau
stops.quote: In Saxony-Anhalt, it runs for over 80 kilometers from Horburg-Maßlau to Eckartsberga.
stops.english: In Saxony-Anhalt, it runs for over 80 kilometers from Horburg-Maßlau to Eckartsberga.
